newsitem.title: GREECE: CITIBANK, ATHENS CUTS BASE MORTGAGE RATE BY 75BPS.
newsitem.headline: CITIBANK, ATHENS CUTS BASE MORTGAGE RATE BY 75BPS.

text.p: Citibank will cut its base rates
for mortgages by 75 basis points to 16 percent effective January
Citibank, which reviews its rates weekly, offers the
** Base rate for working capital loans at 16.75 percent
** Business and professional base lending rate at 17.50 percent
** Base rate for freely investible funds at 17 percent
** Mortgage rate at 16 percent from 16.75 percent
** Personal installment loans with invoices at 23 percent
Contribution under Law 128 is not included in the rates
Base rates on working capital loans in foreign currency for
Citibank slashed its base savings rate to 10 percent from
10.25 percent. It also decreased its other deposit rates.
